sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Merge Dice are straightforward yet engaging. The game starts with a set of random dice, and your goal is to merge dice of the same value to create higher-value dice. The game has a simple drag-and-drop interface, allowing you to drag a dice onto another dice of the same value to merge them. Each successful merge will reward you with points and unlock new levels. As you progress through the levels, the game increases the difficulty by introducing new dice values, obstacles, and challenges. The game also has a 'boost' feature, which allows you to boost your merging power for a limited time, giving you an extra edge in challenging levels.

One of the unique features of Merge Dice is its ability to combine dice values in multiple ways. For example, you can merge three dice of the same value to create a higher-value dice, or merge two dice of different values to create a new dice value. This feature adds a layer of depth to the game, making it more challenging and engaging. The game also has a 'shuffle' feature, which randomizes the dice on the board, forcing you to think on your feet and adjust your strategy accordingly.

In summary, the core gameplay mechanics of Merge Dice are simple yet engaging, making it an excellent game for players of all ages and skill levels.
